note: Literature confirms overweight in 59% of a 45-patient ACBD6 cohort, with diabetes mellitus and renal failure reported only in a single family of 2 siblings.

evidence.text: In a study of 45 affected individuals with bi-allelic ACBD6 variants aged 1 to 50 years, overweight was documented in 59% of patients alongside complex movement disorders.

source.title: Bi-allelic ACBD6 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with progressive and complex movement disorders
source.quote: The affected individuals (23 males and 22 females), aged 1-50 years, typically present with a complex and progressive disease involving moderate-to-severe global developmental delay/intellectual disability (100%) ... overweight (59%), microcephaly (39%) and epilepsy (33%).

evidence.text: A report of two Thai siblings with an ACBD6 duplication identified previously unreported manifestations including morbid obesity, diabetes mellitus, cirrhosis, and renal failure.

source.title: Neurodevelopmental Disorder, Obesity, Pancytopenia, Diabetes Mellitus, Cirrhosis, and Renal Failure in ACBD6-Associated Syndrome: A Case Report
source.quote: Clinical manifestations that have never been previously reported include morbid obesity, pancytopenia with severe infections, diabetes mellitus, cirrhosis, and renal failure, leading to deaths in their early 30s.
